body:
section .text
global _start
_start:
    mov rax, 60
    xor rdi, rdi
    syscall

section .data
    msg db "Hello, world", 10
    len equ $ - msg
section .text
global _start
_start:
    mov rax, 1

add_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    add rax, rsi
    ret

sub_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    sub rax, rsi
    ret

mul_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    imul rax, rsi
    ret

div_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cqo
    idiv rsi
    ret

mod_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cqo
    idiv rsi
    mov rax, rdx
    ret

max_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    ret

min_two:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rdi, rsi
    cmovg rax, rsi
    ret

abs_val:
    mov rax, rdi
    neg rax
    cmovs rax, rdi
    ret

negate:
    mov rax, rdi
    neg rax
    ret

swap:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov ecx, [rsi]
    mov [rdi], ecx
    mov [rsi], eax
    ret

strlen_custom:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    cmp byte [rdi + rax], 0
    je .done
    inc rax
    jmp .loop

my_memcpy:
    mov rcx, rdx
    rep movsb
    ret

my_memset:
    mov rcx, rdx
    mov al, sil
    rep stosb
    ret

strcmp_custom:
.loop:
    mov al, [rdi]
    mov cl, [rsi]
    cmp al, cl
    jne .different
    test al, al

reverse_string:
    xor rcx, rcx
    mov rdx, rdi
.len:
    cmp byte [rdx + rcx], 0
    je .start
    inc rcx

to_upper:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    mov cl, [rdi + rax]
    test cl, cl
    je .done
    cmp cl, 'a'

to_lower:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    mov cl, [rdi + rax]
    test cl, cl
    je .done
    cmp cl, 'A'

sum_array:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    add eax, [rdi + rcx * 4]

max_array:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov edx, [rdi + rcx * 4]

min_array:
    mov eax, [rdi]
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov edx, [rdi + rcx * 4]

count_evens:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov edx, [rdi + rcx * 4]

count_positive:
    xor eax, eax
    xor ecx, ecx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    cmp dword [rdi + rcx * 4], 0

linear_search:
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .missing
    cmp [rdi + rcx * 4], edx
    je .found

count_occurrences:
    xor eax, eax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    cmp [rdi + rcx * 4], edx

binary_search:
    xor rcx, rcx
    mov r8, rsi
    dec r8
.loop:
    cmp rcx, r8
    jg .missing

bubble_sort:
    xor rcx, rcx
.outer:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    xor rdx, rdx
.inner:

insertion_sort:
    mov rcx, 1
.outer:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov eax, [rdi + rcx * 4]
    mov rdx, rcx

factorial:
    mov rax, 1
.loop:
    cmp rdi, 1
    jle .done
    imul rax, rdi
    dec rdi

fib:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rdx, rax

climb_stairs:
    mov rax, 1
    mov rcx, 1
.loop:
    cmp rdi, 1
    jle .done
    mov rdx, rax

gcd:
.loop:
    test rsi, rsi
    jz .done
    xor rdx, rdx
    mov rax, rdi
    div rsi

power:
    mov rax, 1
.loop:
    test rsi, rsi
    jz .done
    imul rax, rdi
    dec rsi

is_even:
    mov rax, rdi
    and rax, 1
    xor rax, 1
    ret

is_prime:
    cmp rdi, 2
    jl .no
    mov rcx, 2
.loop:
    mov rax, rcx
    imul rax, rcx

count_set_bits:
    xor rax, rax
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rcx, rdi
    and rcx, 1

is_power_of_two:
    test rdi, rdi
    jle .no
    mov rax, rdi
    dec rax
    and rax, rdi
    jz .yes

sum_digits:
    xor r8, r8
    mov rcx, 10
.loop:
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rax, rdi

reverse_bits:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rcx, 32
.loop:
    shl rax, 1
    mov rdx, rdi
    and rdx, 1

is_palindrome:
    xor rax, rax
    mov rdx, rdi
.len:
    cmp byte [rdx + rax], 0
    je .start
    inc rax

single_number:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    xor rax, [rdi + rcx * 4]

missing_number:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .finish
    xor rax, rcx

atoi:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
    mov r8, 1
    cmp byte [rdi], '-'
    jne .loop
    mov r8, -1

clamp:
    mov rax, rdi
    cmp rax, rsi
    cmovl rax, rsi
    cmp rax, rdx
    cmovg rax, rdx
    ret

sign:
    xor rax, rax
    test rdi, rdi
    jz .done
    mov rax, 1
    jg .done
    mov rax, -1

sum_squares:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov rdx, [rdi + rcx * 4]

fill_array:
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rsi
    jge .done
    mov [rdi + rcx * 4], edx
    inc rcx

count_vowels:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    mov dl, [rdi + rcx]
    test dl, dl
    jz .done

dot_product:
    xor rax, rax
    xor rcx, rcx
.loop:
    cmp rcx, rdx
    jge .done
    mov r8d, [rdi + rcx * 4]
